profile.headline: Generalist software engineer with experience in distributed systems, reliability engineering, building startups, and engineering leadership.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Engineering Manager for Backend Platform and Computer Vision teams.

Built a scalable mobile 3D capture pipeline which produced and served 3D models at high volume via the Display.land app.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked primarily on high scale messaging infrastructure, including Twitter's internal self-serve publish subscribe system EventBus. Also helped build DistributedLog, a shared log service which underpins many distributed systems at Twitter.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Owned improvements to execution environment and transactions infrastructure in the SQL Server RDBMS engine. Later, helped make the RDBMS engine work reliably as the foundation of SQL Azure.
